name: Reset Request to Email Sent
summary: The user submits an email address, the server requests password-reset delivery, and the client shows the reset-email-sent confirmation view.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.request is visible

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Email address associated with the account requesting recovery.

serverInteraction.intent: Request password-reset delivery without disclosing whether the submitted email identifies an account.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.sent is visible
